title: AMC 10 Practice: Floor Function Sums — The Number You Can Never Make
description:
AMC 10 practice problem on sums of floor functions, counting which numbers from 1 to 1000 can be made, solved two ways. (Level 4 of 5)
Round down a number, its double and its triple, then add: you can never make 1000! Which numbers from 1 to 1000 CAN you make?
Vantee shows two ways to count them: draw the staircase and count the skips, or count the numbers that work row by row.
Then try a floor-of-four-x variant on your own.
